operatorProperties.code:
def process(contributors2024):
    import pandas as pd

    df = contributors2024.copy()
    # The file is a formatted table; the true header row appears in-row as:
    # Year | Data Contributor | # of Reports | %
    header_mask = (df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Year') & (df.iloc[:, 1].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Data Contributor')
    if not header_mask.any():
        raise ValueError("Could not locate embedded header row with 'Year' and 'Data Contributor'.")

    header_idx = header_mask.idxmax()  # first True
    data = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].copy()
    data.columns = ['Year', 'Data Contributor', '# of Reports', '%']

    # Keep only the FTC - Web Reports (IDT) rows for years 2022-2024
    data['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(data['Year'], errors='coerce')
    target = data[(data['Year'].between(2022, 2024)) & (data['Data Contributor'].astype(str).str.strip() == 'FTC - Web Reports (IDT)')].copy()

    if target.empty:
        raise ValueError("No rows found for 'FTC - Web Reports (IDT)' in years 2022-2024.")

    # Parse reports as integer (values include thousands separators)
    target['# of Reports'] = (
        target['# of Reports']
        .astype(str)
        .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
        .str.strip()
    )
    target['# of Reports'] = pd.to_numeric(target['# of Reports'], errors='coerce')

    total = int(target['# of Reports'].sum(skipna=True))
    return pd.DataFrame([{'totalFraudsFtcWeb20222024': total}])
